method: Read-only docker exec python3 via stdin; /proc/PID/exe and /proc/PID/maps only; SHA256 of mapped shared-library files and executables; no environment or command-line reads
scope: Actual df_*, gunnersvr, zergsvr, secagent, DnfGateServer and socat (actual executable socat1) processes in final ALL and split deployment nodes. The selector also included zergsvr_secagent and forward; secagent is the actual executable name. Database proxy scripts use socat; forward is an inactive retained legacy tool covered by static ELF inspection, not a required running component. Includes shared objects loaded by dlopen. Identical executable/library mappings grouped with process_count; PIDs omitted.
limitations: Point-in-time mappings include only libraries still mapped when sampled. Previously unloaded or future dlopen libraries and anonymous executable mappings are outside this inventory.
